stories.title: FBI reportedly declares ‘cyber security incident’ after hackers steal agents’ personal data
stories.summary: The FBI reportedly declared a cybersecurity incident after hackers obtained agents' personal information, including Social Security numbers. TechCrunch said the bureau had warned its agents about the exposure but had not publicly confirmed a breach.

links.headline: FBI reportedly declares ‘cyber security incident’ after hackers steal agents’ personal data
links.excerpt: The bureau has not yet publicly confirmed a breach, but has told its agents that their personal information and Social Security numbers were exposed.
